# MacOSCleaner

> Free source-available macOS cleaner and app uninstaller for Apple Silicon. Offline, no telemetry. Personal use only.

Canonical product name: **MacOSCleaner** (also referred to as macOS Cleaner / Mac Cleaner).
Requires macOS 26.0+, Apple Silicon (M1+). Current release: v2.2.0.
License: Dual-licensed under GNU GPLv3 + Commons Clause v1.0 (Custom Non-Commercial) and Commercial License.
Author: AlexTkDev — ORCID https://orcid.org/0009-0002-8907-5406


## Pages & Docs

- [Product site](https://alextkdev.github.io/MacOSCleaner/): Landing page with core features, interactive screenshot showcase, changelog, and direct DMG download
- [About & FAQ](https://alextkdev.github.io/MacOSCleaner/about.html): Deep-dive into cache safety, forensic uninstaller leftovers, developer cleanup (Xcode, Docker, Homebrew), privacy model, and FAQs
- [How to clean Xcode caches safely on Mac](https://alextkdev.github.io/MacOSCleaner/guides/clean-xcode-caches-mac.html): DerivedData, DeviceSupport, CoreSimulator, DocumentationCache; keep Archives and dSYMs
- [Clean Docker disk space on Mac](https://alextkdev.github.io/MacOSCleaner/guides/clean-docker-mac-disk-space.html): docker system df and prune; never delete Docker.raw
- [macOS System Data is too large](https://alextkdev.github.io/MacOSCleaner/guides/macos-system-data-too-large-developers.html): Developer reclaim order (Xcode → Docker → simulators → caches → thinlocalsnapshots)
- [Support the Project](https://alextkdev.github.io/MacOSCleaner/support.html): Support options (Ko-fi and Crypto donations), Apple Developer Program ($99/yr) notarization funding goal, and Supporter Hall of Fame
- [Full agent brief](https://alextkdev.github.io/MacOSCleaner/llms-full.txt): Self-contained product facts for AI agents
- [XML Sitemap](https://alextkdev.github.io/MacOSCleaner/sitemap.xml): Indexable URLs for search engines and crawlers

## GitHub & Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/AlexTkDev/MacOSCleaner): Source code (reference / personal study)
- [Latest release](https://github.com/AlexTkDev/MacOSCleaner/releases/latest): Download DMG / release notes
- [v2.2.0 release notes](https://github.com/AlexTkDev/MacOSCleaner/releases/tag/2.2.0): Forensic Leftovers Uninstaller, Project Build Artifacts with Age Filters, APFS Disk Analyzer, 1,887 paths
- [v2.1.1 release notes](https://github.com/AlexTkDev/MacOSCleaner/releases/tag/2.1.1): Root-owned app uninstaller batching, Touch ID for sudo helper, Spotlight reindex, Version SoT
- [v2.1.0 release notes](https://github.com/AlexTkDev/MacOSCleaner/releases/tag/2.1.0): AppIntents & Siri support, Duplicate File Finder, Apple Watch-style disk visualization, 10 localizations
- [Issues](https://github.com/AlexTkDev/MacOSCleaner/issues): Bug reports and feature requests
- [License](https://github.com/AlexTkDev/MacOSCleaner/blob/release/LICENSE): Dual-licensed under GNU GPLv3 + Commons Clause v1.0 / Commercial
